automated-vote-without-user-verification: INV-005: an assertion without user verification is not a vote. No automated process can produce a user-verified assertion from a hardware authenticator.
vote-without-evidence-digest: A vote on evidence nobody can reconstruct is worthless: the digest pins what was in front of the delegate.
abstention-as-a-vote-value: Abstention is the absence of a cast vote (PENDING), never a vote value folded into the tally.
